title: PearlCalc
description: Shows Ender Pearl trajectory and predicted landing damage before you throw.
body:
![Pearl Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e717ced021bd013041b67027bf7ce4329b8f997f.png)

![Pearl Preview Water](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2b117a5b5bc5308138ce2391b5e70afb5e8b05fa.png)

- Shows real-time Ender Pearl trajectory path before throwing

- Displays predicted landing damage instantly

- Detects safe landings → shows 0 damage on water, slime blocks, and vines

- Automatically adjusts damage preview if wearing Feather Falling boots

- Helps plan safe teleports, clutch saves, and precise throws
